textBlockTranslation.value: Thirty-eight storeys above Seri Kembangan, wrapped in a retail podium and four levels of amenity deck. Built for the way Klang Valley actually lives.

Seventeen years of Bumiputera property development across Selangor, Negeri Sembilan, Melaka, Johor and Kedah — from a single detached house in Kota Warisan to a 3,442-unit pipeline carried on a gross development value of RM 1.307 billion.

Ehsan Plant & Property Sdn Bhd aims to provide services and products according to established standards and produce work results with the highest quality, while also contributing to the country's economic development — and aspires to be a progressive and advanced Bumiputera company in property construction.

value: To create environmentally friendly and contemporary modern property constructions.
To provide affordable asset ownership facilities to the public — Everyone Can Own A House — together with Ehsan Property.
To become a competitive leader in the real estate industry in Malaysia.
To always consider the company motto We Build For Your Needs.
To become a visionary and competitive company
To have efficient and effective operational time management
To be innovative and maintain integrity
To instil a team spirit that values sincerity
To provide the best quality and satisfaction to our customers

articles.body:
The key handover ceremony and launch of Surau Al-Hajaran took place on Saturday, 8 February 2025, at Taman Mawar Ehsan in Rembau.

The event was officiated by Ehsan founder and CEO, Dato’ Haji Abdul Hamid bin P.V. Abdu. It marked the handover of keys to homeowners and the introduction of the surau as a place of worship and community gathering.

A shared space for the community

Surau Al-Hajaran is intended to support religious activities and strengthen connections among residents. Its launch represents an important milestone for the growing Taman Mawar Ehsan community.

Ehsan thanks the homeowners, residents and team members who helped make the event possible. We wish all new homeowners a warm welcome and many happy years in their new homes.
articles.title: Key Handover and Surau Launch at Taman Mawar Ehsan
articles.excerpt: A key handover ceremony and the launch of Surau Al-Hajaran brought residents and the Ehsan team together in Rembau on 8 February 2025.
articles.subtitle: Homeowners receive their keys as the community celebrates the launch of Surau Al-Hajaran in Taman Mawar Ehsan, Rembau.

articles.body:
Ehsan Widuri is a planned integrated development in Nilai, Negeri Sembilan, designed to bring residential and commercial spaces together.

A connected location

Nilai is home to institutions including Universiti Sains Islam Malaysia, Nilai University and MILA University. Access to nearby amenities and the airport area contributes to its appeal as a place to live.

Designed around everyday life

The development is planned in two phases, with serviced apartments in Blocks A and B alongside commercial spaces and parking facilities. Shared facilities, including a wedding and exhibition hall, are intended to support both residents and community events.

A focus on community

Ehsan Widuri reflects the group’s approach to creating homes that respond to residents’ needs, with attention to practical design and connected living.

Plans and specifications may change as the development progresses. For the latest availability, layouts and project details, please contact the Ehsan sales team.
articles.title: Introducing Ehsan Widuri in Nilai
articles.excerpt: Ehsan Widuri brings together serviced apartments, commercial spaces and shared facilities in Nilai, with a focus on everyday convenience and community life.
articles.subtitle: Discover Ehsan Widuri, a planned residential and commercial development bringing connected living to Nilai, Negeri Sembilan.

articles.body:
Ehsan celebrated the handover of completed homes at Taman Universiti Bestari in Sungai Petani, welcoming homeowners to their new neighbourhood.

A phased residential development

The project includes single-storey terrace homes and semi-detached homes across multiple phases. At the time of the original update, Phases 1 to 4 had sold out, with further phases under development.

The location offers access to AIMST University and surrounding schools, healthcare facilities and retail amenities.

Supporting homeowners

The handover provided an opportunity for the Ehsan team to meet residents and discuss after-sales support. The company remains focused on delivering homes and supporting communities as they grow.

For current phase availability and construction updates, please contact the Ehsan sales team.

articles.subtitle: Ehsan celebrates a residential handover milestone with homeowners at Taman Universiti Bestari in Sungai Petani, Kedah.

articles.body:
Anda mungkin tertanya-tanya sama ada pendapatan semasa mencukupi untuk membeli rumah, dan jenis rumah yang sesuai dengan kemampuan anda.

Bagi pembeli kali pertama, memahami proses pembelian dan kos yang terlibat merupakan langkah awal yang penting. Kelayakan pembiayaan bergantung pada penilaian institusi kewangan dan keadaan kewangan setiap pemohon.

Artikel ini merupakan perkongsian umum, bukan pengesahan kelayakan pinjaman. Dapatkan maklumat terkini daripada institusi kewangan sebelum membuat keputusan pembelian.
articles.title: Kelayakan Membeli Rumah Berdasarkan Pendapatan
articles.excerpt: Pendapatan ialah salah satu faktor dalam menilai kemampuan membeli rumah. Pembeli kali pertama juga perlu mengambil kira komitmen bulanan dan kos pembelian.
articles.subtitle: Kenali perkara asas yang perlu dipertimbangkan apabila menilai kemampuan membeli rumah berdasarkan pendapatan dan komitmen bulanan.

articles.body:
Sebelum membeli rumah pertama, luangkan masa untuk memahami persediaan dan kos yang diperlukan.

  1. Sediakan modal. Kenal pasti dana yang diperlukan untuk pembelian rumah.
  2. Semak maklumat KWSP. Jika bercadang menggunakan simpanan KWSP, rujuk syarat dan kelayakan pengeluaran semasa melalui saluran rasmi KWSP.
  3. Kenali pemaju. Semak latar belakang dan kredibiliti pemaju sebelum membuat keputusan.
  4. Fahami kos pembelian. Ambil kira kos yang berkaitan dengan pembelian rumah, bukan harga hartanah sahaja.

Perkongsian ini bersifat umum. Syarat pembiayaan dan pengeluaran simpanan boleh berubah; dapatkan maklumat terkini daripada pihak berkaitan.
articles.title: Empat Tip untuk Membeli Rumah Pertama
articles.excerpt: Persediaan awal membantu pembeli kali pertama memahami keperluan kewangan dan perkara penting sebelum membeli rumah.
articles.subtitle: Empat perkara asas untuk pembeli rumah pertama: persediaan modal, maklumat KWSP, pemilihan pemaju dan kos pembelian.

articles.body:
Pada 20 November 2020, Dato’ Haji Abdul Hamid bin P.V. Abdu, Pengarah Urusan Ehsan Group of Companies, mengadakan lawatan kerja ke tapak projek Taman Mawar Ehsan di Rembau.

Lawatan tersebut bertujuan meninjau kemajuan pembinaan rumah teres dua tingkat bagi Fasa 2. Pada waktu itu, Fasa 2 telah dibuka untuk jualan selepas Fasa 1 habis dijual.

Selepas lawatan, taklimat penyelarasan projek diadakan di bilik mesyuarat tapak bersama pengurus besar, jurutera dan kontraktor untuk membincangkan pelaksanaan projek.
articles.title: Lawatan Tapak ke Taman Mawar Ehsan
articles.excerpt: Pada 20 November 2020, Pengarah Urusan Ehsan Group of Companies melawat tapak Taman Mawar Ehsan di Rembau untuk meninjau kemajuan pembinaan Fasa 2.
articles.subtitle: Lawatan kerja ke Taman Mawar Ehsan, Rembau, meninjau kemajuan pembinaan Fasa 2 dan menyelaras pelaksanaan projek.
